description: React component for a performance dashboard displaying metrics, error counters, and per-stream data, with data fetched via custom hooks and API calls.

methods.name: formatGbps
methods.description: Formats a number as a Gbps string with 2 decimal places, or '--' if invalid.

methods.name: formatPct
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string with 3 decimal places, or '--' if invalid.

methods.name: formatTs
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a locale string, or '--' if invalid.

methods.name: renderErrorCounters
methods.description: Renders a list of error counters, sorted by value and name, or a message if none.
